name: LMArena
tagline: Crowdsourced LLM leaderboard where humans vote on anonymous model battles.
description: An open evaluation platform where a user enters a prompt, two anonymous models answer side by side, and the user picks the better response. Those millions of blind pairwise votes are aggregated into Elo-style rankings across text, vision, coding, and other arenas. It works directly with major AI labs and has become the most-cited public reference for comparing frontier model quality.
insight: Spun out of UC Berkeley's LMSYS Chatbot Arena; raised $150M at a $1.7B valuation in January 2026.

modelSupport.notes: Hosts and compares all major frontier models from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, xAI and others.

edge: Ranks models on millions of real human head-to-head votes instead of static benchmarks — the most-cited public LLM leaderboard.
cons: Crowd votes can be noisy or gamed
A leaderboard, not a dev test harness

references.title: LMArena lands $1.7B valuation four months after launching its product
